elements: inverse-time phase overcurrent (IEC 60255-151 family) and high-set phase overcurrent

test_plan.inverse_points: multiples of the study pickup, three shots per point, high-set element blocked
test_plan.high_set_points: two shots at 1.5 x the study high-set pickup
test_plan.between_shots: recorded load current played back; current off while the breaker is open after a trip

timer_stop_input: binary input 1 on the trip circuit at the breaker cubicle
test_set: fault current stops at the first touch of the binary input
